              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as title + ' ' + lastName when a title is present,
                or just the lastName when no title is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a space, then the
                national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field
                stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: A unified member identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' - the region derived from the owner's postcode (falling back to city, else UNKNOWN), the 2-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone + lastName), and a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of <REGION><FY><HASH8>.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D9'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the 2-digit fiscal-year segment of the memberId (the fiscal year, starting 1 July, of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate). Null when the memberId is absent.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable, deterministic household identifier, the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode). Owners with the same last name and postcode share the same value automatically; null when no postcode is present.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key: the lower-case, 64-character SHA-256 hex
                digest of (normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName)). A create
                is rejected with 409 Conflict only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an
                existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was created, that shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, assigned on creation. Starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more members, plus 3 for a tenure of one or more elapsed fiscal years (each starting 1 July) between the registrationDate and today.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true

              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:

              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:

              type: integer

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'PHONE'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-

      type: object

          readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When present it is used to
            compose the owner's 'salutation' as title + ' ' + lastName; otherwise the salutation is
            just the last name.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it takes precedence.
            On reads this is the composed, normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1'
            with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When supplied (non-blank)
            it is preferred over the flat 'address' input. Normalized and returned on reads.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. When present it is
            normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-0-9 ().+]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the owner's
            city per the fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present the owner's ageBand is derived from it,
            computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already belongs to the same
            household (same last name and postcode, hence the same computed householdId), declaring
            the owner an additional member of that household. Otherwise such a request is rejected
            with 409 Conflict. The householdId itself is always computed from the last name and
            postcode; this flag only bypasses the household-duplicate block and suppresses the
            possible-duplicate flag for the declared member. Write-only control flag; the flag itself
            is not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The version-2 owner identity: the group of stable identifiers derived for an owner. Every
